summary: Sprott Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian material-change/current report) on November 3, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a 25% increase in its quarterly dividend and declaration of the Q3 2026 distribution. The board declared US$0.50 per common share, payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business November 16, 2026. Canadian-registry and CDS-held holders receive Canadian dollars at the December 1 spot rate; DTC/Cede holders and non-Canadian registered holders receive US dollars, with currency elections due before the record date. The dividend is designated an eligible Canadian dividend; no advisor named. Watch for payout-ratio sustainability and any follow-on buyback or special-dividend signaling.
